scope: Final asset delta validation plus explicitly attributed complete baseline regression. The final fixed routes and static normal/bevel triangulation are changed geometry; they are not claimed identical to the baseline. This report does not claim that all complete motion or 1444 dimension-stability frames were rerun against final assets. Independent model-engineering interference/clearance audits and actual browser QA are maintained by root.

dimension_stability_carry_forward.reason: Dimension algorithm/CSS and all frontend sources are unchanged; closed cabinet dimensions, all 19 measured mechanical tray boxes, tray/door parent coordinates, and 35 native cable morph meshes were compared against the baseline. New fixed routes and static normal/bevel changes are covered by the separate final delta and model-engineering audits, not by retroactively relabeling the baseline stability frames.
